leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the aspect-ratio property to maintain proportional dimensions of an element.
Configure aspect-ratio values for common shapes like squares and widescreen rectangles.
Manipulate aspect-ratio to control responsive behavior across viewport sizes.
Integrate aspect-ratio with other CSS properties like width or max-width for flexible layouts.
Construct a media container that preserves its intended proportions without manual height calculations.
Update existing CSS rules to replace fixed height declarations with dynamic aspect-ratio.
Initialize aspect-ratio on images and videos to prevent layout shifts during loading.
